source_caption:
Jim Carrey accepted a much lower salary to star in Dumb and Dumber than he had just earned for Ace Ventura: Pet Detective, because he loved the script so much. After the success of his previous films, the studio quickly renegotiated and paid him a massive salary—making him one of the highest-paid comedy stars in Hollywood.

Dumb and Dumber (1994), directed by Peter Farrelly & Bobby Farrelly, starring Jim Carrey, Jeff Daniels, Lauren Holly. A wildly absurd road-trip comedy where two clueless friends cross the country to return a briefcase, leaving a trail of chaos, misunderstandings, and unforgettable jokes behind them.

source_details.title: Dumb and Dumber
source_details.synopsis: Dumb and Dumber is a 1994 American road buddy comedy film directed by Peter Farrelly, who cowrote the screenplay with his brother Bobby and Bennett Yellin. It is the first installment in the Dumb and Dumber franchise. Starring Jim Carrey and Jeff Daniels, it tells the story of Lloyd Christmas (Carrey) and Harry Dunne (Daniels), two dumb but well-meaning friends from Providence, Rhode Island, who set out on a cross-country road trip to Aspen, Colorado, to return a briefcase full of money to its owner, unaware it was left as a ransom.
